title: Saudi-Led Coalition Strikes Hundreds of Houthi Targets, Destroys Northern Yemen Ballistic Missile Depot
detail: The Saudi-led coalition launched a major air campaign striking hundreds of Houthi military targets across Yemen, including the destruction of a depot in northern Yemen reported to house 20 ballistic missiles. The intensified air offensive follows the Yemeni government's announced drive to retake all Houthi-controlled territory. The strikes represent a significant escalation in coalition air activity as ground operations by government forces advance toward Sanaa.

media.caption: Saudi-led coalition claims destruction of depot housing 20 ballistic missiles in northern Yemen

title: Saudi Arabia Reaffirms Support for Internationally Recognized Yemeni Government
detail: Saudi Arabia reaffirmed its diplomatic and military support for the internationally recognized Yemeni government, framing the Houthi movement as an illegitimate coup requiring sustained international pressure. The statement underscores continued Saudi commitment to restoring Yemeni state authority as coalition and government forces press offensives toward Houthi-held territory.

title: Saudi Arabia Officially Confirms Two Airports Struck by Houthis
detail: Saudi Arabia officially confirmed that two of its airports were struck by Houthi forces in renewed fighting, a significant official acknowledgement corroborating earlier Houthi claims. Coalition air operations against Houthi targets in Yemen continue amid the broader escalation in the conflict.
